project: Live End-to-End Tests: Chief CLI + Chief Uplink
description: Build a live end-to-end test suite that validates the full pipeline between the chief CLI and the chief-uplink Laravel web app. Unlike existing tests that mock one side, these tests run all real processes: a real chief serve process, real Reverb WebSocket server, real Laravel app, and a real browser via Dusk. The PRD also addresses critical bugs discovered in the settings and PRD chat flows that prevent these E2E tests from passing.

userStories.title: Fix CLI PRD Message Types (prd_output / prd_response_complete)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the CLI to send prd_output and prd_response_complete message types during PRD sessions so that the browser can distinguish PRD streaming from run streaming and properly clear the "thinking" indicator. Currently, internal/cmd/session.go sends claude_output (with Done: true for completion) for all output, but PrdChat.vue listens for prd_output and prd_response_complete which never arrive. This is the primary cause of the stuck "thinking" indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TypePRDOutput = "prd_output" and TypePRDResponseComplete = "prd_response_complete" constants in internal/ws/messages.go
Add corresponding message structs: PRDOutputMessage with a Text field (json:"text") and PRDResponseCompleteMessage
In internal/cmd/session.go, the streamOutput function sends prd_output messages (with text field) instead of claude_output when running in a PRD session context
When the PRD session's Claude process exits, send a prd_response_complete message instead of claude_output with Done: true
Existing claude_output behavior for non-PRD run sessions remains unchanged
Add prd_output and prd_response_complete to the batcher's tier routing if needed
Unit tests pass for the new message types

userStories.title: Fix CLI Field Name Mismatches (new_prd, prd_message)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the CLI's message structs to match the field names the browser actually sends so that PRD creation and chat messages are not silently lost. There are two field name mismatches: 1) new_prd: Browser sends "message" but CLI's NewPRDMessage expects "initial_message" — the user's first message is lost. 2) prd_message: Browser sends "message" but CLI's PRDMessageMessage expects "content" — subsequent chat messages are lost.
acceptanceCriteria: In internal/ws/messages.go, change NewPRDMessage.InitialMessage JSON tag from "initial_message" to "message" (or add both tags)
In internal/ws/messages.go, change PRDMessageMessage.Content JSON tag from "content" to "message" (or add both tags)
The CLI correctly receives and processes the user's message text from new_prd commands
The CLI correctly receives and processes subsequent prd_message content
Update any contract fixtures in contract/fixtures/ that reference these field names
Existing unit tests updated and passing

userStories.title: Implement refine_prd Handler in CLI
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the CLI to handle the refine_prd command so that users can edit existing PRDs from the web UI. Currently, serve.go's handleMessage switch has no case ws.TypeRefinePRD: — the command is silently dropped. The browser sends refine_prd with project, session_id, prd_id, and message fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TypeRefinePRD = "refine_prd" constant in internal/ws/messages.go if not already present
Add RefinePRDMessage struct with Project, SessionID, PrdID, and Message fields
Add case ws.TypeRefinePRD: in serve.go's message handler switch
Implement handleRefinePRD that loads the existing PRD by ID, spawns a Claude session with the edit prompt (from embed/edit_prompt.txt) and the user's message as context
The refine session streams prd_output messages back (per US-001) and sends prd_response_complete on completion
Add contract fixture for refine_prd in contract/fixtures/server-to-cli/
Unit tests for the new handler

userStories.title: Fix PrdChat.vue Error Handling and Stuck States
userStories.description: As a user, I need the PRD chat to properly recover from errors so the UI never gets permanently stuck on the "thinking" indicator. Currently, isClaudeResponding is set to true before sendCommand is awaited. If sendCommand returns null (network error, 503, etc.), there is no cleanup — the thinking indicator stays forever.
acceptanceCriteria: Add error handling after sendCommand in handleSend() — if the command fails (returns null), reset isClaudeResponding = false and remove the streaming placeholder message
Add a timeout safety net (e.g., 3 minutes) that clears isClaudeResponding and shows an error if no prd_output or prd_response_complete arrives
Verify that error type messages from the CLI properly reset the chat state
The chat UI never gets permanently stuck in the "thinking" state

userStories.title: Install and Configure Laravel Sail for PostgreSQL + Redis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Docker containers for PostgreSQL and Redis so the E2E tests have isolated database and cache infrastructure without requiring local installation. Sail is already listed as a composer dependency (laravel/sail ^1.41) but has not been installed yet — there is no docker-compose.yml at the project root.
acceptanceCriteria: Run php artisan sail:install --with=pgsql,redis to generate docker-compose.yml at the project root
Edit the generated docker-compose.yml to remove the laravel.test PHP app container (we only need pgsql and redis — the app runs on the host because chief CLI must run on the host to spawn claude)
Keep pgsql (PostgreSQL 17) on port 5432 and redis (Redis Alpine) on port 6379
Ensure the SailServiceProvider is registered in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php (Sail's installer typically adds it, but verify it's present and gated behind app()->environment('local'))
Verify Docker is running, then run ./vendor/bin/sail up -d pgsql redis and confirm both containers start successfully
Verify PostgreSQL is accessible: ./vendor/bin/sail exec pgsql pg_isready -U sail returns success
Verify Redis is accessible: ./vendor/bin/sail exec redis redis-cli ping returns PONG
Add docker-compose.yml to version control
Add a brief comment at the top of docker-compose.yml noting that the laravel.test container was intentionally removed (app runs on host for E2E tests)

userStories.title: Create E2E Environment Configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a .env.dusk.e2e environment file that configures the Laravel app to connect to Sail-provided PostgreSQL and Redis, use a real Reverb WebSocket server, and run in testing mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Create .env.dusk.e2e with settings per the E2E_TESTING_SPEC.md (DB on localhost:5432, Redis on localhost:6379, Reverb on port 8085, queue=sync, session=file)
APP_URL set to http://127.0.0.1:8001
Reverb configured with test app ID, key, and secret
VITE_REVERB_* variables set for frontend WebSocket connection
BCRYPT_ROUNDS=4 for fast test user creation
The file is checked into version control (no real secrets)

userStories.title: Create E2E Setup Artisan Command
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an artisan command (e2e:setup) that seeds all test data — user, device, workspace with git repo, config, PRD files, and valid HMAC credentials — so the E2E test suite has a fully working environment.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/Console/Commands/E2ESetupCommand.php with signature e2e:setup {--workspace=}
Creates test user via User::factory()->create() with email e2e-test@example.com
Creates DeviceAuthorization for the user with device_name: e2e-test-device
Generates a valid HMAC access token replicating DeviceOAuthController::generateAccessToken() logic (base64 payload + HMAC-SHA256 signature using app key)
Generates a refresh token and stores bcrypt hash in device record

Creates test workspace at {workspace}/projects/test-project/ with: git init + initial commit, .chief/config.yaml (maxIterations: 5, autoCommit: true, etc.), .chief/prds/feature-auth/prd.md and prd.json (3 sample stories)
Writes CLI credentials to {workspace}/.chief-home/.chief/credentials.yaml in the format expected by internal/auth/auth.go
Outputs JSON with all generated IDs, paths, and tokens to stdout
Command is idempotent (can be re-run safely)

userStories.title: Fix DuskTestCase Chrome Binary Path
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Dusk test case base class to work on macOS so E2E tests can run locally, not just in Linux CI. Currently tests/DuskTestCase.php hardcodes /usr/bin/chromium which doesn't exist on macOS.
acceptanceCriteria: Make the Chromium binary path conditional: only set setExperimentalOption('binary', '/usr/bin/chromium') if the file exists (Linux CI)
On macOS, let ChromeDriver auto-detect Chrome at its default location
Dusk tests launch Chrome successfully on both macOS and Linux

userStories.title: Create E2E Orchestration Script
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a master orchestration script (tests/LiveE2E/run.sh) that handles the full lifecycle of starting infrastructure, seeding data, launching all processes, running tests, and cleaning up.
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/LiveE2E/run.sh per the E2E_TESTING_SPEC.md plan
Script checks prerequisites (chief, php, node, docker in PATH)
Starts Sail containers (PostgreSQL + Redis) and waits for PostgreSQL readiness (up to 30s)
Backs up existing .env, copies .env.dusk.e2e into place
Creates test database, runs migrations, runs e2e:setup
Builds frontend with npm run build
Starts Reverb on port 8085, Laravel on port 8001, and chief serve pointing at localhost
Waits for chief CLI to connect (polls is_online on DeviceAuthorization, up to 30s)
Runs Dusk tests: php artisan dusk tests/LiveE2E/LiveEndToEndTest.php
Cleanup trap: kills all spawned processes, restores .env, removes temp workspace
Exits with the Dusk test exit code
Script is executable (chmod +x)
